guitar.evidence: Depeche Mode is a synth-pop band; guitar is not central to their sound and no member is a guitarist-led figure with documented signature gear.

tone.target: clean jangly synth-pop guitar with chorus and delay
tone.profile: clean jangly synth-pop guitar with chorus and delay
tone.summary: A sparkling, chorus-drenched signal chain built around a US Deluxe amp model, providing the necessary jangly synth-pop texture with subtle grit and stereo delay.
